show.description: After a plane crash, billionaire heir Amar Luthra survives with amnesia and is saved by kind-hearted surgeon Dr. Rumi. While greedy nurse Nisha fakes Amar’s death to seize the Luthra empire, Amar lives as a nobody beside the woman who saved him—until love, truth, and a ruthless conspiracy collide, forcing him to reclaim his identity before Rumi loses everything.
